datumEvidence: Collection-level expected datum only; original tile metadata and transformation logs were not retained with this cache.
limitations: Immutable input is a previously resampled and quantized grid, not the original survey raster.
No independent surveyed checkpoints or dataset-specific accuracy certificate are bundled.
Acquisition epoch, datum realization, original tile hashes and any nodata-fill mask need recovery before survey acceptance.
Copernicus GLO-30 is a 30 m surface model, not a survey of bare-earth terrain or current snow.
